technical_decisions: Đọc source module owner trước khi sửa. Dữ liệu hiển thị/chọn không được thay đổi BRep khi chỉ có ý định đo hoặc kiểm tra.
Undo/Redo và save/reopen phải bảo toàn document state, errors phải hữu hình và có test cụ thể.
Giá trị đo trên metric double precision, không lấy kích thước từ screenshot/mesh viewer; phân biệt length/angle/area/volume.

positive.setup: Create the geometry and select the inputs required by: object dimension summaries
positive.expected: Distance is 5mm for reference points; other measurement dimensions report correct type/units and do not modify BRep.

negative.setup: Try missing/invalid references or cancel during: Bounding Size And Center Measurement
negative.expected: Explicit domain error; document IDs, BRep cache, selection and undo journal unchanged

invariants: No success with only tessellation when an exact BRep is required
Do not infer success from an unrun test

golden_test_design.negative_assertions: zero bodies or transformed hidden geometry incorrectly included

m03_luna_execution_contract.manual_references_precision: Many references are inherited parent-L2 page ranges, not command-exact citations
invariants: OCCT BRep/Geom is truth for exact geometry; mesh/tessellation only derived
No partial document commit on failure or cancellation
Stable object and subobject identity or explicit broken-reference error
No fabricated test receipts, measured values, or manual review

backend not implemented => disabled with visible reason, never deceptive success
